Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Wildwood, Cape May County, New Jersey, July 1923, Sheet 109

sheet-108.description: Sheet 108 is an additional sheet of July 1923 for the New Jersey Coast volume 4, covering the oceanfront of Wildwood at 50 ft to an inch with north towards the upper left. It shows four full blocks between East Spencer Avenue at the top and East Montgomery Avenue at the bottom, with East Youngs, East Roberts and East Baker Avenues crossing between them. Atlantic Avenue runs along the left edge, Ocean Avenue through the middle and Beach Avenue along the right, where the Boardwalk is drawn in yellow hatching as a frame structure on the line of the avenue. Beyond the Boardwalk the sheet shows open beach and the shoreline of the Atlantic Ocean in blue. The blocks between Atlantic and Ocean Avenues (block numbers 121, 113, 104 and 95) are divided into numbered lots and are almost empty: only four small dwellings are drawn. The blocks between Ocean and Beach Avenues (122, 114, 105 and 96) carry dashed boardwalk approaches along their street sides; their Beach Avenue frontage has rows of small stores, most densely in block 96 at East Montgomery Avenue, where a run of stores lettered A to H fronts both streets, with a small storage building behind. A further boardwalk spur runs along the north side of East Montgomery Avenue and turns diagonally across Atlantic Avenue at the lower left. Street widths of 60 ft are lettered on the cross streets and 40 ft on Beach Avenue. Block numbers of the adjoining area (86, 87) appear below East Montgomery Avenue, and key numbers 42 and 40 and the adjoining sheet number 109 are printed in the margins. A compass rose, the sheet title and a scale bar occupy the beach and margin on the right.
notes: The modern Boardwalk follows the line of Beach Avenue as drawn here; Beach Avenue itself is not a street in OpenStreetMap at this point.
Atlantic Avenue is drawn about 48 ft wide, against a right-of-way of about 70 ft in today's parcels.
Stamped OCT 11 '23 beside the sheet number.

Map, 50 ft to an inch, one part. Printed sheet 108, N.J. Coast Map vol. 4, additional sheet July 1923 (stamped Oct 11 '23). Wildwood beachfront between E. Spencer Av (top) and E. Montgomery Av (bottom), Atlantic Av to Beach Av and the Boardwalk, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean shoreline. North towards the upper left (rotation about -47 deg).

sheet-109.description: Sheet 109 is an additional sheet of July 1923 for the New Jersey Coast volume 4, covering the oceanfront of Wildwood at 50 ft to an inch with north towards the upper left. It continues sheet 108 to the north, from East Cedar Avenue at the top, cut along its centre, to East Spencer Avenue at the bottom, with East Schellenger, East Lincoln, East Garfield and East Spicer Avenues crossing Atlantic Avenue on the left, Ocean Avenue in the middle and Beach Avenue on the right, where the Boardwalk is drawn in yellow hatching. The beach beyond carries a small pavilion on piles and a water closet, and the shoreline of the Atlantic Ocean is drawn in blue. The block above East Schellenger Avenue between Ocean and Beach Avenues (block 160) is an amusement ground with the Old Mill, a roller coaster building, a carousel and a large figure-eight roller coaster track drawn in outline; the block to its left (44) is blank. The four blocks between Atlantic and Ocean Avenues (152, 145, 137 and 129) are divided into lots and nearly empty apart from the Jackson Apartments. Between Ocean and Beach Avenues block 153 is marked as ruins of fire with a store built on piles, block 146 has a dwelling and rows of stores built on piles, block 138 holds Hunt's Regent Moving Picture Theatre with stores along its Beach Avenue entrance, and block 130 has a dwelling, a storage building and stores. Dashed boardwalk approaches line the Ocean to Beach blocks, a 4 inch water pipe is marked in East Lincoln Avenue, and fire hydrants and an alarm box are shown. Key numbers 44, 42 and 50 and the adjoining sheet number 108 are printed in the margins; a compass rose and scale bar sit on the beach.
notes: Roller coaster is lettered ROLLER CORSTER on the building in block 160.
Ocean Avenue has no junction with East Cedar Avenue in OpenStreetMap today; the block between them is a single large lot.
The modern Boardwalk follows the line of Beach Avenue as drawn here.
The town name Wildwood is pencilled by hand under the sheet title, not printed.
Stamped OCT 11 '23 beside the sheet number.

Map, 50 ft to an inch, one part. Printed sheet 109, N.J. Coast Map vol. 4, additional sheet July 1923 (stamped Oct 11 '23). Wildwood beachfront between E. Cedar Av (top, cut at its centre) and E. Spencer Av (bottom, cut), Atlantic Av to Beach Av and the Boardwalk: roller coasters, Old Mill and carousel (block 160), Hunt's Regent Moving Picture Theatre. North towards the upper left.
